checkpoints.name: Vendor Workflow 2.9.0's release tree from its published archive: the sync tool's subset gains the optional forge and gate-policy scripts, the 2.5.1, 2.6.0 and 2.7.0 trees stay byte-unchanged, and the per-release subset test and sync tests cover the new paths

The installed-release test and the live-repository admission test admit a legacy-validated release or a protocol release by capability and nothing else, and the vendored 2.9.0 tree is runnable: installed into a disposable repository the Controller admits it in protocol mode and its verify is healthy

Documentation and the move rehearsal: development and compatibility pages say what is vendored and that the update follows as a chore pull request, a real Workflow Manager update of a scratch clone to 2.9.0 passes the complete CI selection (Controller tests, live admission test, every installed conformance suite) with these tests and fails InstalledReleaseTest without them, check_docs and the full suite green
